items.title: Celebrating 140 Years of Toynbee Hall: a legacy of Empowerment and Community
items.summary: Toynbee Hall recently marked a momentous milestone, its 140th anniversary. Supporters, beneficiaries and local friends gathered to celebrate and reflect on our enduring mission to break down barriers and empower communities.
